findings.evidence: ghostcopyeditor/api.py:129-136 documents this contract: each sync call runs on a new loop, async clients bound to another loop may fail, LLM checks fail soft, and async callers should use check_chapter_async. The only consumer, Autonomicon agents/gce_check.py:141-149, follows it: the sync check_chapter path passes no LLM clients, and the rewrites path builds role_llms inside its own asyncio.run loop and awaits check_chapter_async.
findings.message: ghostcopyeditor/api.py:129–136 — Silent loss of LLM findings. Callers reusing async clients from sync code can receive an apparently successful check with missing LLM notes, making unchecked chapters appear to pass.
